en.headline: Police arrest 321 in two-month anti-drug operation, seize HK$130m drugs
en.dek: Operation Defender from mid-July to late August netted 234 cases and more than 230 kg of suspected narcotics, including a marked rise in etomidate products, police said.
body: Police Narcotics Bureau officers, working with regional units, concluded a territory-wide anti-drug drive codenamed Defender that ran from 12 July to 29 August. The force said 321 people aged 13 to 72 were arrested in 234 cases.

Among those detained were 247 men and 74 women, including 19 boys and nine girls. They face charges including manufacturing, trafficking or possession of dangerous drugs, operating a drug den and possession of Part I poisons. Some have already been charged.

Officers seized about 231 kg of suspected drugs with an estimated street value of HK$130 million. The haul included roughly 76 kg of suspected cocaine, 65 kg of suspected ketamine, 3.7 litres of liquid etomidate and about 6,400 etomidate-laced vape cartridges, plus heroin, cannabis and methamphetamine.

Police noted a significant increase in the quantity of etomidate products recovered compared with the same period last year. They said drug traffickers continue to target young people with small payments to carry or sell drugs in an attempt to shift legal liability onto minors. One 14-year-old girl arrested in the operation was alleged to have been induced to traffic 17 etomidate cartridges.

The force warned that etomidate use can cause serious health effects including nausea, a sharp drop in blood pressure and irreversible neurological damage, and pledged to keep prioritising the protection of young people from drug crime.

zh.headline: 警方暑假反毒行動拘321人 檢值1.3億元毒品
zh.dek: 代號「捍衛者」行動由7月中至8月底進行，偵破234宗案件，檢獲逾230公斤懷疑毒品，依托咪酯相關產品數量明顯上升。
body: 警方毒品調查科聯同各總區人員於7月12日至8月29日在全港展開代號「捍衛者」的打擊毒品行動，共偵破234宗案件，拘捕321人，年齡介乎13至72歲。
被捕人士包括247名男子及74名女子，當中有19名男童及9名女童，涉嫌製造、販運或管有危險藥物、經營毒窟及管有第一部毒藥等。部分人已被落案起訴。
行動中檢獲約231公斤不同種類懷疑毒品，市值約1.3億元，包括約76公斤懷疑可卡因、約65公斤懷疑氯胺酮、約3.7公升液態依托咪酯及約6,400粒含依托咪酯煙彈，另有海洛英、大麻及冰毒等。
警方指檢獲的依托咪酯相關毒品數量較去年同期同類行動明顯上升，並關注毒販以微薄報酬利誘青少年運毒或販毒，企圖將法律責任轉嫁未成年人。行動中一名14歲女童涉嫌被利誘販運17粒依托咪酯煙彈。
警方強調使用依托咪酯可引致噁心嘔吐、血壓急降甚至不可逆轉的神經系統損傷，並會繼續優先打擊涉及青少年的毒品罪行。
